title: Moeb signals should be pushable to GitHub Issues
description: Signals are currently local-only. For collaborative projects and for operating the autonomous loop against a remote repository, signals should be publishable as GitHub Issues: moeb-origin signals to the moeb repository, project-origin signals to the project repository. Without this, the signal catalogue cannot participate in a remote workflow or be visible to collaborators. Depends on separate-moeb-and-project-signals.
proposed_resolution: Implement moeb signal push [--source moeb|project] that reads open signals from the catalogue filtered by signal_source and creates GitHub Issues via the GitHub API (using the configured token from .moeb/.secrets). Each issue must include: signal_id in the body, severity as a label, category as a label, and proposed_resolution as the issue description. Tag all created issues with a moeb-signal label. Record the created issue URL as github_issue_url in the signal catalogue entry to prevent duplicate creation on subsequent pushes.
